# fivenines_organization (Resource)

Manages the settings of the organization the API key belongs to. An API key resolves exactly one organization, so this is a singleton: there is no create and no delete, and only `name` is writable. Applying it renames the organization; destroying it removes the resource from Terraform state and leaves the organization untouched. Requires the `admin` or `owner` role on a plan that includes team features.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The organization an API key belongs to. There is only ever one, so this
# resource has no create and no delete: applying it renames the organization,
# destroying it just drops the resource from state.
resource "fivenines_organization" "this" {
  name = "Acme Corp"
}

# The read side carries the plan and the seat accounting, so a pipeline can
# check for room before it tries to invite somebody.
output "seats_remaining" {
  value = fivenines_organization.this.seats_remaining
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the organization. The only writable field.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `display_name` (String) `name` when set, otherwise `slug`. What the dashboard renders.
- `id` (Number) Organization ID.
- `members_count` (Number) Number of members.
- `pending_invitations_count` (Number) Number of invitations sent but not yet accepted.
- `plan` (String) Effective plan — a trialing organization reads as the plan it is trialing.
- `seats_remaining` (Number) Seats still available. Check this before inviting rather than parsing a 422.
- `seats_total` (Number) Total seats on the plan. Null when the plan is unmetered.
- `seats_used` (Number) Members plus pending invitations — an unaccepted invite holds a seat.
- `slug` (String) Stable URL identifier. Read-only.
- `trialing` (Boolean) Whether the organization is in a trial.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An API key resolves exactly one organization, so the import ID is ignored —
# any placeholder works.
terraform import fivenines_organization.this organization
```
